display.purpose: Illustrated Developer title; final size varies across the recorded responsive cascade.

headline.purpose: Viewer run title; clamps at narrow widths.

summary-title.purpose: Launch summary heading, with compact tablet sizing.

rationale.purpose: Readable public rationale in a white inset.

metadata.purpose: Counts, timestamps and compact supporting UI.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Lifts the transient model configuration dialog; backdrop is #24201966.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Temporary status feedback above the working framework.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Source button, link and platform-choice feedback.

motion.name: toast-transition
motion.purpose: Toast fades while moving 10px into position.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition: none !important; animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important;
motion.purpose: The source reduced-motion query disables transitions and animation.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Launch and save actions use the source indigo capsule.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m8 5 11 7-11 7Z"/></svg>启动模拟<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;padding:11px 19px;border-radius:28px;font-weight:500;border:1px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;background:var(--ink,#2c3352);color:#fff;}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424b75;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default;}.ds-primary svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Low-emphasis actions use a cool outlined capsule.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;padding:11px 19px;border-radius:28px;font-weight:500;border:1px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;background:var(--stone,#f0f3fc);color:var(--ink,#2c3352);border-color:#e2e7f2;}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e8edfa;}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default;}

components.name: Text action
components.description: Quiet add and navigation actions use periwinkle hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-text" type="button">进入 Viewer <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-text{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:4px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--body,#4a536f);font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-text:hover{color:var(--accent,#5264b6);}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-text svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;width:16px;height:16px;}

components.name: Experiment name field
components.description: Associated labels and white controls keep form entry legible.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">实验名称<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="例如：摄影创作者的社区运营" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;color:var(--body,#4a536f);font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;}.ds-input{min-width:0;min-height:44px;width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid #dce2ef;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--body,#4a536f);font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:400;caret-color:var(--ink,#2c3352);}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#5b6680);opacity:1;}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;outline-offset:2px;border-color:#8c9dc8;}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-input{font-size:16px;padding-inline:11px;}}

components.name: Mode navigation
components.description: Two links preserve the current page and a keyboard focus cue.
components.html: 开发者Viewer
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:32px;background:#f0f2fc;}.ds-nav-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 19px;border-radius:26px;color:var(--muted,#5b6680);text-decoration:none;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-nav-active{background:#3d486f;color:#fff;}.ds-nav-link:hover:not(.ds-nav-active){color:var(--ink,#2c3352);background:#e8edf8;}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-nav svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-nav-link{padding:9px 10px;font-size:12px;gap:6px;}.ds-nav svg{display:none;}}

components.name: Run status
components.description: Text and a current-color dot communicate real run states.
components.html: 已完成已暂停进程中断

components.name: Platform choice
components.description: The selected Xiaohongshu source card keeps its rose plane, strong edge, tick and pressed state.
components.css: .ds-platform{position:relative;min-width:0;text-align:left;padding:17px 14px 13px;border:2px solid #c9658b;border-radius:14px;background:#ffe8f1;color:#26304b;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-platform:hover{border-color:#c9658b;}.ds-platform:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-platform-check{position:absolute;top:13px;right:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:17px;height:17px;border:1px solid #5262a0;border-radius:50%;background:#5262a0;color:#fff;}.ds-platform-check svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;width:12px;height:12px;stroke-width:2.4;}.ds-platform-logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;background:#ff2442;color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;}.ds-platform-name{display:block;margin:14px 0 8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;}.ds-platform-copy{margin:0 0 16px;color:#5d627c;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;}.ds-platform-caption{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;color:#5d627c;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;}.ds-platform-caption>span{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex-shrink:0;}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-platform{padding:13px 9px;}.ds-platform-name{font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 0;}.ds-platform-copy,.ds-platform-caption{display:none;}.ds-platform-check{top:9px;right:7px;width:13px;height:13px;}}

components.name: Selected account
components.description: The source account selector combines avatar, role, action count and pressed state.
components.css: .ds-actor{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:100%;padding:12px 8px;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:#e5ecff;color:var(--ink,#2c3352);text-align:left;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-actor:hover{background:#e5ecff;}.ds-actor:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-avatar{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:33px;height:33px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;background:#e8edf9;color:#48557c;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;}.ds-actor-copy{min-width:0;flex:1;}.ds-actor-name{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:4px;}.ds-actor-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--muted,#5b6680);font-size:11px;}.ds-role{font-size:10px;color:#925112;background:#ffead1;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 4px;}

components.name: Exact replay bar
components.description: Circular controls and the native range retain the source playback hierarchy.
components.html: 12 / 18
components.css: .ds-replay{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:#eef2ff;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body,#4a536f);}.ds-replay-buttons{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}.ds-replay-step{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--canvas,#fafbff);color:var(--body,#4a536f);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-replay-play{width:38px;height:38px;background:#42507d;color:#fff;}.ds-replay-step:hover{background:var(--canvas,#fafbff);}.ds-replay-play:hover{background:#42507d;}.ds-replay-step:focus-visible,.ds-range:focus-visible,.ds-speed:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4058b7);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-replay svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-range{flex:1;width:0;min-width:24px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--ink,#2c3352);cursor:pointer;}.ds-replay-count{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-speed{width:49px;padding:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-family:"Agora Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-size:12px;}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-replay{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:10px;}.ds-replay-buttons{gap:4px;}.ds-replay-step{width:28px;height:28px;}.ds-replay-play{width:32px;height:32px;}.ds-range{min-width:56px;}.ds-speed{font-size:16px;width:52px;margin-left:auto;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-replay-step{transition:none;}}

components.name: Official illustrated wordmark
components.description: The actual header image preserves the supplied Agora identity; preview uses the repository-local derivative.

narrative.overview:
Agora Studio is a clear social-world workbench with an illustrated, anime-influenced identity. The user-supplied Agora wordmark and world illustration establish the personality: cool indigo drawing, blue and lavender planes, and small pink, peach and golden details. A near-white working canvas and readable controls give the artwork room without making configuration or replay visually busy.

This design system applies exclusively to the Developer and Viewer outer framework in `agora/web/studio.html`, `studio.css` and `studio.js`. Xiaohongshu, X/Twitter and Reddit iframe documents retain their native typography, color, layout and interaction. The illustrated identity belongs to branding and orientation; account actions, observations, counts and public rationales remain actual interface content.
keyCharacteristics: Official illustrated image branding, reused at appropriate sizes rather than redrawn as a CSS logo.
Near-white canvas, indigo ink, blue and lavender grouping surfaces, and restrained pastel platform choices.
Rounded Latin headings and legible bilingual controls with self-hosted fonts and system Chinese fallbacks.
Flat working surfaces, fine outlines, capsule actions and brief state transitions.
A strict visual boundary around each native social-platform iframe.

rules.name: The Native Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply these tokens to the outer framework only. Preserve the independent visual system inside each platform iframe.

rules.name: The Readable Control Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented mobile field and select text size (16px), including platform, experiment and replay-speed selectors.

rules.name: The Honest Illustration Rule
rules.body: Use the approved Agora artwork for branding and orientation. Never present illustration as account data, a simulation outcome or evidence of model capability.

dos: Do reuse the supplied Agora wordmark and icon/world derivatives, preserving proportions, illustration detail and transparent edges.
Do keep the near-white canvas and indigo text as the framework baseline; use blue and lavender planes to group work.
Do keep the three platform choices distinct with their implemented pink, blue and peach surfaces, borders and pressed states.
Do retain keyboard focus outlines, associated field labels, the dialog title, actor pressed states and readable mobile controls.
Do preserve the selected historical step and the same iframe when expanding or restoring the platform stage.
Do use short state transitions and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't return to the rejected single warm-yellow form treatment or the earlier terracotta-and-stone framework palette.
Don't replace the illustrated wordmark with the obsolete CSS brand-mark or a text-only approximation.
Don't generate replacement mascot art or copy third-party cartoon characters; extend the approved artwork vocabulary with restrained color and simple accents.
Don't apply studio typography, palette or decorative artwork to the native social-platform documents.
Don't add ambient shadows to every working card or continuous floating, particle or looping animation.
Don't let artwork overlap labels, choices, launch actions or replay controls at narrow widths.
